summary: Generating complete, coherent, and usable 3D indoor scenes from natural language requires strong design intelligence: the ability to design high-quality scenes and critique their quality. However, existing approaches either rely on general-purpose models lacking domain-specific design experience or learn from static scenes.
takeaways: In this work, we introduce Scene-Designer, an agentic framework that learns design intelligence through complementary design and critique experiences.

Extensive experiments demonstrate that Scene-Designer achieves superior performance in physical validity, functional correctness, and layout coherence, while the learned Scene-Critic significantly outperforms general-purpose models in scene critique.
However, existing approaches either rely on general-purpose models lacking domain-specific design experience or learn from static scenes.
